verdict.rationale: Supermemory uses AI to derive synthesized knowledge from ingested data. It automatically extracts memories from raw content and maintains user profiles of facts, which is a glancing form of AI-generated insight. However, these outputs are delivered as retrieval primitives through the API, and nothing shows insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product, including the consumer app. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions shown in the product UI, any evidence of a suggestion or recommendation feature, evidence of insight features in app.supermemory.ai, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: User profiles are automatically maintained collections of facts about your users that Supermemory builds from all their interactions.
Profiles update as users interact with your system
